_comment: SLICE 0: hand-written, deliberately fake build state. Slice 1 replaces this
with a generator that reads a real hack's actual contents.
The numbers here are chosen to be distinctive -- 3 caught / 2 seen / 4 items /
3 badges is a combination that cannot plausibly arise by accident in a stock
Emerald new game (which has 0 of everything). That is what lets verification
prove the ROM is reflecting THIS file rather than just booting.
